entries.title: Released GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: 发布面向复杂端到端任务的旗舰模型GPT-6 Astra。

entries.title: Added new controls for long-running work with GPT-6 Astra in the Responses API
entries.summary: Responses API新增异步工具调用、中途引导及推理强度调整。

entries.title: Updated API errors so applications can distinguish traffic that increases too quickly from temporary model overload.
entries.summary: 更新API错误码，以区分流量增长过快与模型临时过载。

entries.title: Mutual TLS (mTLS) and X.509 workload identity federation are now generally available for the OpenAI API.
entries.summary: OpenAI API正式支持mTLS和X.509工作负载身份联合。

entries.title: Announced the deprecation of `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize`.
entries.summary: 多款转录模型将于2027年2月26日停用，Assistants API亦已关闭。

entries.title: API customers can now select regional processing for an individual request by using a prefixed domain with an API key from a project having Global geography.
entries.summary: API客户现可按单个请求选择区域处理。

entries.title: GPT-5.6 Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens
entries.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol输入价降20%，输出价降33%。

entries.title: Released the Prompt Caching dashboard on the OpenAI API platform.
entries.summary: 上线提示缓存仪表板，可分析命中率及缓存令牌使用情况。

entries.title: Transparent backgrounds are now available in preview for `gpt-image-2` and `gpt-image-2-2026-04-21` in the Images API and the Responses API image generation tool.
entries.summary: GPT Image 2在图像及Responses API中预览支持透明背景。

entries.title: Announced Ultrafast mode
entries.summary: 公布GPT-5.6 Sol超高速模式，速度最高为标准处理的14倍。

entries.title: Daybreak now offers two access tiers for approved defenders: Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red.
entries.summary: Daybreak面向获批防御人员推出Blue和Red两级访问方案。

entries.title: Updated the chat-latest snapshot
entries.summary: 更新chat-latest快照，指向ChatGPT Plus和Pro最新模型。
